scientific_integrity: The result is presented with its exact hypotheses and explicit unproved extensions. No independent validation or historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts F_q-linear simultaneous complete mappings for two fixed automorphisms of F_q^2, not nonlinear bijections or higher dimensions. Equivalent older matrix-completion or finite-geometry enumeration remains a priority risk. Direct enumerations cover q=2,3,4,5 only; the symbolic proof covers all prime powers.
title: Seven rational-canonical strata for simultaneous linear complete mappings of two-dimensional finite vector spaces
